statuses.AI-proposed: written or reproduced by an AI; never a human reference
statuses.human-reviewed: the development reviewer (Phillip Wikes) recorded a label on a dated completed form under reviews/
statuses.disputed: the human label and the AI-proposed label differ; both kept
statuses.adjudicated: a person named by the owner settled a dispute; who and when recorded

rule: A status changes only when a dated completed form or an adjudication record exists. This register records no human label: none has been given. Agreement between the Engine and an AI-proposed label is not accuracy.

completed_forms_found.checked: 2026-10-27, and again on 2026-10-28 before the 0.3.4 freeze: search of the repository for a completed reference form or a reviews/ folder
